title: Pseudo-solutions of polynomial systems and the lower bound problem for $\mbox{AC}^0[p]$-Frege systems
summary: The problem to establish a lower bound for $\mbox{AC}^0[p]$-Frege refutations of a system of polynomial equations over ${\bf F}_p$ was in K. (2024) reduced to the existence of a pseudo-solution (a notion defined there) for the system. Here we reduce this further, for the system expressing the negation of the PHP, to a property of search trees querying values of linear maps on the vector space of low degree polynomials over ${\bf F}_p$.
